recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up is needed unless future generated JSON pages regress to broken canonical-form targets.
issue_request: FHIR-6324 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core request to fix generated JSON view pages, such as valueset-marital-status.json.html, whose "canonical form" links led to 404s.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-6324-tagged commit was found. Jira comments marked the issue fixed on 2015-07-20, and the adjacent 2015-07-19 commit f51982040455436f5bace90a3fc1613871e6c4d4 changed the JSON/XML example templates as part of fixing many broken links.
additional_context: Current source still includes ValueSet as an active resource and the MaritalStatus binding that yields valueset-marital-status pages. The current build and published specification render valueset-marital-status.json.html with a canonical form link to valueset-marital-status.canonical.json, and that target returns HTTP 200. Searches found no later Jira, Zulip, or Confluence evidence requiring a different generated link behavior.
reconciliation: No source files were changed because the active template/source state and current rendered pages already satisfy the request.

related_jiras.note: Search hit about replacing FHIR JSON canonicalization with RFC 8785; it was Resolved - No Change and does not concern broken generated canonical-form links.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 issue reporting that JSON view canonical form links, including valueset-marital-status.json.html, led to 404s and were later marked fixed.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final request as a non-substantive generated-link correction.

evidence_items.summary: The current JSON example template emits Raw JSON with <%prettyname%> and canonical form with <%canonicalname%>.
evidence_items.learned: The source delegates the canonical target to the generator rather than hard-coding the stale broken link reported in Jira.

evidence_items.summary: ValueSet remains an active current-build resource and the MaritalStatus binding still names valueset-marital-status.
evidence_items.learned: The Jira example page family is still relevant current build scope, so checking the rendered link is meaningful.

evidence_items.summary: A 2015-07-19 commit titled as fixing many broken links changed source/template-example-json.html and source/template-example-xml.html just before Jira was marked fixed.
evidence_items.learned: This is the likely historical application path even though no explicit FHIR-6324-tagged commit was found.

evidence_items.command: curl -fsSL https://build.fhir.org/valueset-marital-status.json.html | grep -i 'canonical form'; curl -fsSL -o /tmp/body -w '%{http_code}' https://build.fhir.org/valueset-marital-status.canonical.json; curl -fsSL https://hl7.org/fhir/valueset-marital-status.json.html | grep -i 'canonical form'; curl -fsSL -o /tmp/body -w '%{http_code}' https://hl7.org/fhir/valueset-marital-status.canonical.json
evidence_items.summary: Both current CI and current published pages link canonical form to valueset-marital-status.canonical.json, and both targets returned HTTP 200.
evidence_items.learned: The reported 404 is not present in the current rendered specification.
